function.name: scad_ai_ide_model_analyze
function.description: Analyze an explicit workspace URI without Preview. Default diagnostics preserves SCAD/CSG CLI diagnostics. mode=verify Full Renders SCAD/CSG to frozen STL or audits standalone STL/3MF without a runtime. Returns snapshot-bound raw format/topology/intersection/shell checks and mesh measurements. Requires Workspace Trust. No source writes, mesh repair, assembly or printability proof. Read units, completeness and UNRESOLVED checks; ok:true means a report was returned, not PASS. After edits analyze again. SCAD and PNG require the selected official CLI.

function.name: scad_ai_ide_model_checkPrintability
function.description: Screen one frozen mesh against an explicit local mm FDM profile: build envelope and numerical overhang triangle candidates only. No thickness, bridges, support, slicer or manufacturing guarantee; printability remains NOT_CHECKED. For v3 choose partId; uses local geometry and print pose, ignoring assembly pose. Existing print assessment reportId reads only. No automatic unit assumption or source compilation. Requires Trust.

function.name: scad_ai_ide_model_compare
function.description: Compare existing v2/v3 reports or explicitly retained baselines, without compilation. Stable identity is Manifest URI + declared partId, or whole document URI for v2. Summaries only; exported mesh changes do not prove local-region preservation. Required constraint removal/changes never count as repair. Optional expectUnchangedPartIds protects whole local mesh and assembly pose. Requires Trust. To CREATE a comparison, pass baselineReportId AND targetReportId. reportId ONLY reads a comparison report returned by this tool; never put a v2/v3 model ID there.

reportId.description: Read a prior comparison result only; not a source v2/v3 model ID.

baselineReportId.description: Frozen v2/v3 model report ID used as the before baseline. Required together with targetReportId to create a comparison.

targetReportId.description: Frozen v2/v3 model report ID used as the after target. Required together with baselineReportId.

function.name: scad_ai_ide_model_getIssue
function.description: Read one issue from a specific analysis report. Optional bounded local CLI evidence; includes runtime, snapshot ID and whether the report is still current. Expired reports are not recomputed implicitly. Historical results are evidence only; analyze the current document before claiming a repair. No source writes or CLI execution. Geometry v2 includes bounded triangle/component/spatial evidence and pagination. Binary mesh issues have model-level positions, never invented source lines.

function.name: scad_ai_ide_model_measure
function.description: Read basic mesh measurements by existing reportId, or explicitly verify a workspace uri first. Report IDs never recompile missing/expired evidence. Includes snapshot/current status, units, scope and unresolved items. Physical volume is returned only when raw topology, self-intersection, shell composition and winding permit it. Based on exported mesh; no analytic surface, assembly or printability proof. Standalone STL/3MF requires no runtime. Workspace Trust required. For assembly v3 reportId, partIds selects declared frozen parts; no implicit assembly compilation. Assembly total volume is not computed.
